name: D&D 2024 Tool Proficiencies
description: Closed character state containing only canonical known SRD 5.2.1 tool-proficiency ids and a fixed source reference. Creation and correction use mechanic.dnd2024.tool-proficiencies.record. An empty list means known no tool proficiencies; absence means unknown state. It stores no tool item, check, craft result, source grant, or derived bonus.
